messages:
marie: quick async check-in — microwindow + kernel warmup tests
marie: what I did: ran two perf sweeps on the microwindow batching branch (w/ kv-prefetch on), collected p50/p95 for 128/512 seqs
marie: results: p50 stable (~14ms/token) but p95 spikes at ~220ms in some shards, can't repro locally yet
marie: blocker: need traces / tail logs from the canary nodes (saw 3 spike events in the canary group)
marie: today: triage traces, open small revert if we see config regression, pinging infra for log access

ada: saw the same spikes earlier this morning on staging, looked like kv-cache miss storms correlated with slot eviction
ada: quick note: when prefetch concurrency was 8 -> 16 the miss rate dropped on avg, but jitter increased

sam: can you paste the flag values you used?

ada: sure — command I ran:
```
export PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=16
export KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.75
./bin/runner --kernel-mode microwindow --batcher=continuous --run=perf
```

lucas: thanks — one thought: if eviction threshold is borderline, background evictor might run and cause short GC-like stalls on the allocator; those show up as p95 spikes

marie: good call. lucas, do you have a lightweight evict profiler we can drop in the canary?

lucas: yes, I can enable a short evict trace (10s) and sample the KV ops. will push a small patch to ops playbook and coordinate a quick rollout.

marie: perfect. infra-bot — can you grant me read access to canary logs for the runtime cluster rwinf-canary-3?

infra-bot: ACL request created: #INC-7812. Notify @infra on approval.

sam: FYI I opened a tiny PR that adds a debug metric for kv.hit_streak_length — helps see short-lived cold tails. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/2487

marie: :thumbsup: will link PR in the incident thread if spikes recur.

ada: small FYI — I re-ran the microwindow test w/ quantized kernels and the p95 improved slightly, but the tail still exists, so looks orthogonal to kernel selection

marie: ok — plan for today: 1) lucas to run evict trace on canary, 2) infra to approve log ACL, 3) marie + sam triage PR + correlate traces, 4) revert knob if clear regression found

lucas: I’ll schedule the trace at 11:20 PST and post results here.

marie: thanks. if anyone sees a blocker (can't get ACL or trace), ping me @marie directly. otherwise brief updates here later today.

deploy-bot: reminder: canary deploy window opens at 11:15 PST. Check health after trace window.
